for index, row in adjacency.iterrows():

    n = len(x)
    mean_x = np.mean(x)
    mean_y = np.mean(y)
    numerator = np.sum((x - mean_x) * (y - mean_y))
    denominator = (n - 1) * np.sum((x - mean_x) ** 2)
    return numerator / denominator
